julia: Heads-up — saw a burst of OOMs on prod ded pool (ded-prod-3) right after the 11:30 deploy. Perf snapshot attached. Anyone else seeing KV prefix hit-rate collapse?
perf-bot: Auto-report: cluster=ded-prod-3 time=2025-11-05T11:34Z OOM_count=6 GPU_mem_util=97% KV_hit_rate=0.21 CPU_hot_cache_frac=0.62 kernel_jitter_ms_p50=0.9 p95=4.1
kevin: I pulled the trace. Root cause looks like a combination of kernel-selection churn + cache churn. The model changed tokenization -> more varied prefix lengths; cache misses spiked, which triggered fallback kernels (quant-int8 -> avx fallback) mid-batch. That kernel swap is causing pipeline stalls.
maria: Hit-rate graph shows KV hit 10:50=0.60 -> 11:35=0.22. GPU cache occupancy increased but fragmentation grew: lots of small occupied slots, free contiguous slots scarce -> evict/compact thrash.
sam: Quick theory: synchronized TTL/evict waves + cold prefix churn. When many prefixes miss simultaneously we do large compactions, which block kernels and cause OOM tail. Proposal: tiered soft-cap with probabilistic evict to smooth waves. Example config: ```eviction:
  mode: tiered
  gpu_soft_cap_percent: 60
  soft_eviction_policy: probabilistic
  probabilistic:
    pin_threshold: 0.8
    decay_per_min: 0.01
  cpu_cache_percent: 40
  promotion_hits: 3
  warmup_ttl_seconds: 300
```
kevin: Also add a kernel-selection heuristic: avoid switching kernels inside a request if possible. If a request misses KV cache early, keep it on the cheaper consistent kernel path rather than switching back-and-forth. In profilers when kernel swap happened mid-request p95 latency up ~28%.
maria: TTL strategy idea: start with conservative long TTL for prefixes that cross a reuse threshold (e.g., promoted after 3 hits in 5m), otherwise give short TTL and promote on reuse. That keeps GPU pinned for hot prefixes and reduces churn.
julia: Sounds good. Regression risk? We need canary and observable changes. What metrics to add?
sam: I'll run a 5% canary with tiered soft-cap + probabilistic evict + TTL promotion enabled. Need new metrics: per-prefix score histogram, eviction_origin tag (gpu/cpu/compaction), prefix_promotion_count, kernel_swap_count_per_req. Quick dashboard panels: KV_hit_by_prefix_cohort, eviction_latency_ms.
kevin: I'll add a lightweight profiling flag to sample kernel-choice sequences and compaction blocks for 1% of requests: `--sample-kernel-path=1%`. That should show correlation without heavy overhead.
maria: Also add a metric for contiguous_free_blocks_percent on GPU slab to surface fragmentation early.

sam: I'll post canary config and logs to the thread when started. plan: enable canary, let run 6h, compare p50/p95 kernel_jitter and KV hit curves, sanity OOM check.
julia: Action items: sam -> run canary; kevin -> add sampling profiler flag; maria -> dashboard + fragmentation metric. We'll regroup tomorrow 10:00 PT. Thanks :thumbsup:
